arabic text: LAHOO BHARRE TERE KADMON KO BIBI LAAKHON SALAAM,
english translation text: COUNTLESS SALUTATIONS TO YOUR BLOOD SOAKED FOOTSTEPS, O LADY

arabic text: TU NE KIYE BARRE MUSHKIL SAFAR MUSAAFIRA SHAAM
english translation text: YOU UNDERTOOK A MOST DIFFICULT JOURNEY, O TRAVELLER TO SHAAM

arabic text: BINNA NALAIN KE KAANTON HAYE PATHARON PE CHALI\nTU KITNI RAATON KI JAAGI TUJHE MILLA NA ARAAM
english translation text: WITHOUT SANDALS YOU WALKED OVER THORNS AND STONES\nHOW MANY NIGHTS YOU HAD STAYED AWAKE, YOU NEVER FOUND REST

arabic text: VARAM HAIN PAIRON MEIN DARBAAR MEIN KHARRI JO RAHI\nNAU GHAINTE TERA MUSALSAL BARRA TAVEEL KAYAAM
english translation text: WITH WOUNDS IN YOUR FEET, YOU STOOD IN THE TYRANT’S COURT\nFOR NINE HOURS YOU REMAINED IN CONTINUOUS ENDURANCE

arabic text: MANAANE BHAI KA CHEHLUM MAI AAGAI KARBAL\nDIKHAYI DETA HAI SAJDA ZAMEEN PE JALTE KHAYAAM
english translation text: TO MARK MY BROTHER’S CHEHLUM (FOURTIETH), I HAVE COME TO KARBALA\nTHE PROSTRATION ON THE GROUND CAN BE SEEN, AMONGST THE BURNT TENTS

arabic text: KAHAN KAHAN NA GIRRI MAI RIDA BACHAANE KO\nSHIMR KE SAAMNE LETI RAHI ABBAS KA NAAM
english translation text: IN SO MANY PLACES I FELL, STRIVING TO PROTECT MY VEIL\nINFRONT OF SHIMR, I KEPT CALLING OUT ABBAS’ NAME

arabic text: NIBHAAYI QAID MAI AAYI HOON TERI TURBAT PE\nKATTE LABON SE KARO TUM HUSSAIN AAJ KALAAM
english translation text: HAVING FULFILLED THE TRIALS OF CAPTIVITY, I HAVE COME TO YOUR GRAVE\nO HUSSAIN, WITH YOUR SEVERED LIPS, SPEAK TO ME NOW

arabic text: MAI BABA AAP KI BEHNEIN TAMAAM LE AAYA\nBEHEN SAJJAD KI MADFAN SAKINA HO GAYI SHAAM
english translation text: O FATHER, I HAVE BROUGHT ALL OF YOUR SISTERS BACK\nBUT THE SISTER OF SAJJAD, SAKINA, HAS BEEN LEFT BURIED IN SHAAM
